Package com.robojacks.lib.estimator

Class PoseEstimator

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.estimator.PoseEstimator
Direct Known Subclasses:
DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator, TrackingWheelPoseEstimator
public abstract class PoseEstimator extends Object
Blends odometry with absolute position measurements (the GPS Sensor), like WPILib's pose estimators. Odometry is smooth but drifts; the GPS doesn't drift but is noisy and sometimes blind. The estimate follows odometry and is pulled toward each measurement by an amount that depends on how much you trust each one (the standard deviations).

Use DifferentialDrivePoseEstimator or TrackingWheelPoseEstimator; this class holds the shared fusion logic.

Measurements can be late (a camera frame from 40 ms ago): pass the time the measurement was taken, and the estimator corrects the pose it had at that time and replays odometry since.

    • PoseEstimator

      protected PoseEstimator(Pose2d initialPose, double[] stateStdDevs, double[] measurementStdDevs)
      Parameters:
      initialPose - where the robot starts
      stateStdDevs - how much odometry drifts per update: x and y in meters, heading in radians (WPILib's default is 0.02, 0.02, 0.01)
      measurementStdDevs - how noisy measurements are: x, y in meters, heading in radians

  • Method Details

    • setVisionMeasurementStdDevs

      public final void setVisionMeasurementStdDevs(double x, double y, double theta)
      How much to trust measurements by default: standard deviations of x and y (meters) and heading (radians). Larger = trust less. For the GPS, a huge heading value (like 1000) keeps the Inertial Sensor in charge of heading.
